answer_1.quote: Automatic open-domain dialogue evaluation is still an open question, and extensive efforts have been made to improve performance from different angles.

answer_2.quote: automatic dialogue evaluation metrics draw growing attention as they can assess dialogues with faster speed and lower cost.

answer_4.quote: We collected human judgements from Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT). The crowd-workers are provided with the full multi-turn conversation for evaluation.
answer_4.guideline: We ask crowd-workers to evaluate the relevancy, avoiding contradiction, avoiding repetition, persona consistency and overall quality of the conversation.
